title: Euphoria Patches
description: Euphoria Patches is an add-on for Complementary Shaders, extending it with more optional features and settings.
body:
##   A Complementary Shaders Add-On

- **Euphoria Patches**, an add-on for Complementary Shaders ([Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined)/[Unbound](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound)), developed by [SpacEagle17](https://linktr.ee/SpacEagle17). - Expands Complementary with optional handcrafted features. - All options are disabled by default but can be individually enabled. A "Popular Settings" tab and preset profile make it easy to apply commonly used options. **Important notice: Please don't report any bugs while using this add-on to Emin, contact information is below.** ## 📥 How To Install: If you don't know how to Install Euphoria Patches, read these instructions: **[euphoriapatches.com/how-to-install/](https://www.euphoriapatches.com/how-to-install)**! ## 🔗 Links * **Support SpacEagle17 on [Patreon](https://www.euphoriapatches.com/support/) and get access to Preview Versions!** * **[Website](https://euphoriapatches.com)** of Euphoria Patches! * **[Changelogs](https://www.euphoriapatches.com/changelogs/)** of Euphoria Patches! * **Contact:** **https://euphoriapatches.com/contact** * Add **[Modded Blocks](https://www.euphoriapatches.com/properties/)** or **[Translation Files](https://www.euphoriapatches.com/lang/)** to Euphoria Patches! ## ❓ FAQ Got anymore questions?
